name: queryEvery
description: This function calls a given closure/function with every element in a given query and returns true, if all of the closure calls returns true.
syntax: queryEvery( query query, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(struct row [number rownumber, query query]) { returns boolean; ).`

params.name: maxThreads
params.description:
maximum number of threads executed,

ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
